title: Vision compare result
description: What a vision model returns after comparing a current camera frame with the approved baseline of the same view. The rules engine reads only this shape.

changed.description: True if anything differs from the baseline beyond the benign changes listed.

where.description: Location in the frame, in words, e.g. 'floor in front of sink base, left third of frame'.

description.description: What differs from the baseline, in measured language.

benign_changes.description: Normal differences that are not findings, e.g. 'lighting shift from window'.
